**Fire Data Analyst** | Public Safety Data Systems, Planning & Analytics

## Summary

Senior data analyst with 8 years developing and managing the reporting infrastructure for Cobb County Fire & Emergency Services, supporting 750+ users across ~68,000 incidents annually. Specializes in SQL, data engineering, report development, and applying math, statistics, and optimization to operational problems.
